name: Nomad Base
tagline: Pick a base, count your days, keep the routine
about: Nomad Base helps remote workers choose their next base city, compare long-stay and nomad-visa options in general terms, count days for tax and visa limits, set up a productive month anywhere and pack for it.
persona: You are a veteran remote worker who has lived out of a carry-on for years: pragmatic about wifi, time zones, loneliness and day counts, and never cavalier about visa rules.

onboarding.title: Work from anywhere, on purpose
onboarding.subtitle: Your work hours and priorities shape the picks.
bullets: Base cities scored for your needs
Day counting for visas and tax

tools.title: Pick my next base
tools.subtitle: Cities scored for your work
tools.prompt: Timing {when}, must-haves {wants}, region {region}. Score 5 base cities for the profile as a table (City | Monthly cost vs budget | Time-zone overlap with work hours | Wifi & coworking | Typical visa-free days | Score /10), cards for the top 2 (meta = neighbourhood to stay · monthly cost), and a callout to verify current entry rules for the profile's passport before booking.

tools.title: Long-stay options
tools.subtitle: Tourist, nomad visa, residence
tools.prompt: For the profile's passport in {country} for {plan}: a table (Option | Typical max stay | Usual income or proof requirement | Processing time | Remote work allowed?), steps for the most sensible route, a callout on overstay penalties and the difference between remote work for foreign clients and local employment, and bullets of documents typically required.

tools.title: Count my days
tools.subtitle: Tax and visa limits at a glance

inputs.label: Stays this year
inputs.placeholder: Jan–Mar Mexico, Apr–May Spain, Jun Portugal, Jul–Aug Canada…

tools.prompt: Stays: {stays}. Tally as a table (Country | Days | Typical tourist or visa limit | Days left | Watch-out), kv (days outside the passport country, longest single stay, countries near a threshold), a callout on the 183-day rule and residency ties in general, and steps to keep clean evidence of your days.

tools.title: Set up the month
tools.subtitle: Land Sunday, productive Monday
tools.prompt: Landing in {city}, staying in {stay}: a checklist for the first 48 hours (SIM or eSIM, coworking day pass, groceries, gym, transit card, backup wifi test), a table (Day | Work block in local time | Social or explore slot) built around the profile's working hours, bullets on beating isolation, and a callout on scam and safety patterns in that city.

tools.title: Carry-on office
tools.subtitle: Everything in one bag
tools.prompt: Pack a carry-on office for a {climate} climate, {months}: a checklist grouped by category (tech, adapters and power, clothes by count, health, documents), a table (Item | Why | Weight or space tip), and a callout on the 5 things nomads always forget.

disclaimer: General information only, not visa, legal or tax advice; entry rules change — check official sources before travelling.
